QuestInfo.name: [Lunar New Year] Fresh Dumplings!
QuestInfo.0:
The tastiest Lunar New Year dumplings you've ever had were just delivered! Get 'em while they're hot!

Did you know they taste even better when you share them?! That's right! When you eat the residents's dumplings, you'll be extra powerful for a whole 15 min! But share them with friends, and that time will be doubled!

#b#eHow to Share Dumplings#n#k
 1. Get the #t2439917:# from Yoria once a day.
 2. Find a friend to help you eat it.
 3. #bRight-click#k the character and click #bShare Dumpling.#k

Tip: #i2023823:# #t2023823:# will activate on both characters once you share a Dumpling. Share Dumpling/Accept Dumpling can each be done once a day.
